title: Attorney Settlement Authority and Consent Judgment Grid — Legal Forwarding Agreements
content:
The grid below sets, for each programme of the Legal Forwarding Agreements, how far a collection attorney may go in resolving a matter on the attorney's own authority once suit is filed: the lowest percentage of the balance or judgment the attorney may accept without client approval, whether the attorney may agree a consent judgment with a payment schedule, and the smallest down payment on a consent judgment.

## Authority grid

| Programme | Lowest percentage acceptable without client approval | Consent judgment with payment schedule | Smallest consent-judgment down payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | 0.0% | No | 0.0% |
| Small Claims Suit Program | 80.0% | Yes | 10.0% |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 80.0% | Yes | 10.0% |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 85.0% | Yes | 15.0% |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | 75.0% | No | 0.0% |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | 80.0% | Yes | 10.0% |

## Definitions

**Lowest percentage acceptable without client approval.** The lowest percentage of the balance or judgment that the attorney may accept without client approval once suit is filed. It reads 0.0% under the Attorney Demand Program, which files no suits.

**Consent judgment.** Whether the attorney may agree a consent judgment with a payment schedule. The Attorney Demand Program and the Judgment Enforcement Program show No.

**Smallest down payment.** The smallest down payment on a consent judgment, as a percent of the judgment; 0.0% where no consent judgments are agreed.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical judgment of $8000.00

| Programme | Lowest amount acceptable without client approval | Smallest consent-judgment down payment |
|---|---|---|
| Small Claims Suit Program | 80.0 percent of $8000.00, $6400.00 | 10.0 percent of $8000.00, $800.00 |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 85.0 percent of $8000.00, $6800.00 | 15.0 percent of $8000.00, $1200.00 |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | 75.0 percent of $8000.00, $6000.00 | no consent judgment |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | 80.0 percent of $8000.00, $6400.00 | 10.0 percent of $8000.00, $800.00 |

Both columns are floors that the stated amount itself meets: under the Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program, $6800.00 is acceptable without client approval and a $1200.00 down payment meets the smallest down payment, while $6799.99 is below the authority and $1199.99 is below the smallest down payment. The judgment figure is hypothetical and used only to show how the percentages read.
